title: Author the ship-checklist contract and validator
description: Add contracts/schemas/v1/ship-checklist.schema.json as a flat markdown-frontmatter schema (required: schema_version const 1.0, project, shipped_at date-time, review_decision const approved, reviewed_at date-time; additionalProperties true, like review-report.schema.json). Add validateShipChecklist(frontmatter, root) to cli/lib/validate.js using validateMarkdownArtifact, export it, import + re-export it in cli/appbuilder.js, and append 'ship-checklist' to REQUIRED_SCHEMA_NAMES. Test-first: validateShipChecklist unit tests (valid frontmatter passes; bad review_decision and missing required fields fail).
acceptance_criteria: ship-checklist.schema.json validates flat frontmatter with review_decision const approved and the required date-time fields.
validateShipChecklist is exported from cli/lib/validate.js and re-exported from cli/appbuilder.js.
